topic.title: Git Client Add-on
topic.shortdesc: The Git Client add-on integrates a full Git client into , enabling you to commit, push, pull, branch, and resolve conflicts without leaving the editor.

body.p: An add-on is available that contributes a built-in Git client directly in . Once the add-on is installed, a Git Staging view is available that includes various actions that perform common Git commands, such as push, pull, change branch, commit, and more. It also includes a built-in tool for comparing and merging changes.
